rewrites.//: Angular is a client-side SPA: every unknown path must return index.html so the router can resolve it. Without this, a deep link like /products/42 is a 404 from the CDN before Angular ever loads.

headers.//: HSTS. Add `preload` and submit to hstspreload.org only once you are certain every subdomain is HTTPS-only.
Angular fingerprints these filenames (outputHashing: all), so they are safe to cache permanently. A new deploy produces new names.
index.html must never be cached, or users keep loading the old app shell after a deploy.
